contents.name: README
contents.contents:
My name is Clark DuVall. I am a Software Engineer at Google working on AI on the web.
This is my website. You can find the source code to make your very own on GitHub.

If you need help, type "help".

You can contact me at clark.duvall@gmail.com or follow me on Twitter @theclarkatron.
